channel.title: Livable Telluride — Weekly Digest
channel.description: This week's upcoming Gov-Hub meetings and community events across the Telluride region (Town of Telluride, Mountain Village, San Miguel County, the Sheridan Opera House, The Alibi, Wilkinson Library, KOTO, telluride.com, and more).

item.title: 📅 The Week Ahead — Nov 22–28
item.description: Thanksgiving week lands squarely in the middle of this stretch, with the Turkey Trot on Thursday morning, Alpine Chapel's free community Friendsgiving kicking things off Sunday, and an Outlaw Thanksgiving at Alloy Kitchen rounding out the holiday. On the government side, every meeting on the books — the Open Space Commission, the BOCC work session, and the Mountain Village Metro District board — has yet to post an agenda, so there's nothing actionable to track down this week.

item.title: [Tue, Nov 24] Around The World: America’s Pumpkin Beer & Chocolate Pretzels
item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Wine Mine, Telluride Owner and Brewmaster, TJ is taking us on a journey to early America to discover how a humble native gourd became our continent’s most iconic seasonal tradition. Long before pumpkin spice became a modern phenomenon, early American colonists relied on native pumpkins to survive winter and celebrate the harvest holidays. Join us for a curated tasting event exploring the rich history of American pumpkin brewing paired with traditional European-style chocolate pretzels. Grab your tasting passport, explore the global trade routes that brought us holiday spices, and toast to the historic flavors of the American harvest season! (Ages 21+ only).

Join Marlen for a high-energy dance fitness class fused with barre, pilates and stretching that mixes low-intensity and high-intensity moves for an interval-style, calorie-burning workout that will tone your body and boost your endurance without even realizing how hard you are working. item.title: [Thu, Nov 26] Turkey Trot 2026
item.description: 🎫 KOTO Dust off those tennis shoes and tail feathers – the Turkey Trot is back! This 5K walk/run is free and fun for the whole family (even Fido!). Sign up online in advance to be entered into a raffle, with additional prizes for the fastest male, fastest female, fastest kid under 12 and best costume. The event will take place at the intersection of Sunshine Mesa Rd. and Ilium Rd. at 9:00 a.m. on Thanksgiving morning, Thursday, November 26th, at 9:00 a.m. Sign up online at bit.ly/smcturkeytrot2026.

item.description: 🎫 KOTO 📍 Lone Cone Library Norwood We are a MOBILE family business offering non-competitive Gymnastics, Preschool Spanish, & Dance classes to the San Miguel County area. Sign up at any time and get started weekly. Fridays — 11:15-11:40 am @ Lone Cone Library Norwood K to 3rd Grade week Session 8 Week Winter Session $150 for the 8 sessions. Thursdays – 430-530 pm @ Lone Cone Library Norwood For more information and to register: Contact Tia @ liv2danz247@gmail.com or find us on Facebook!
